lines.t: To abide in the doctrine of the Messiah
Is not mere proclamation or belief
To abide in his doctrine
Is to live by his words
A shining example of righteousness
Striving always to make your love
Perfect through obedience
That those close to you
Even the passerby
May see your good works
And glorify
Your Father in heaven
For it is written
One does not live on bread and water alone
But by every word that comes from the mouth of God
So do not just give voice and preach
But abide in the doctrine of the Messiah
Abide in the doctrine of the Messiah
By example shall you lead them
By example shall you lead them
Abide in the doctrine of the Messiah
Abide in the doctrine of the Messiah
Thank you for watching!
